title: verbena angustilobata
intro: Verbena angustilobata, commonly known as Chinese Vervain, is a plant species native to China, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Verbena angustilobata include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as verbascoside, caffeic acid, and luteolin. These bioactive constituents are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine.
